name: blueline
description: Local, rule-based data lineage for SSAS modernization projects. Paste SQL, DAX, or Power Query source; Blueline traces table- and column-level lineage with a real SQL parser (no AI, no API key) — or build the diagram by hand. Optional LLM-backed Q&A and reports on top.
author: Bernadino T. Domongdong (https://bernadinodomongdong.github.io/mysite/)
